# Data Source: stripe_treasury_financial_account

A Treasury financial account that holds money on a connected account. Look one up by its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connected_account" {
  type        = string
  description = "The connected account the object lives on."
}

provider "stripe" {
  alias          = "connected"
  stripe_account = var.connected_account
}

data "stripe_treasury_financial_account" "operating" {
  provider = stripe.connected
  id       = "fa_1MtYCCLkdIwHu7ixUqlIQr8T"
}

output "financial_account_balance" {
  value = data.stripe_treasury_financial_account.operating.balance.cash
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the treasury financial account to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `active_features` - The array of paths to active Features in the Features hash.
* `balance` - Balance information for the FinancialAccount See [`balance`](#balance) below.
* `country` - Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `features` - Encodes whether a FinancialAccount has access to a particular feature. Stripe or the platform can control features via the requested field. See [`features`](#features) below.
* `financial_addresses` - The set of credentials that resolve to a FinancialAccount. See [`financial_addresses`](#financial_addresses) below.
* `is_default` -
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `metadata` - Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
* `nickname` - The nickname for the FinancialAccount.
* `pending_features` - The array of paths to pending Features in the Features hash.
* `platform_restrictions` - The set of functionalities that the platform can restrict on the FinancialAccount. See [`platform_restrictions`](#platform_restrictions) below.
* `restricted_features` - The array of paths to restricted Features in the Features hash.
* `status` - Status of this FinancialAccount. Possible values: `closed`, `open`.
* `status_details` - See [`status_details`](#status_details) below.
* `supported_currencies` - The currencies the FinancialAccount can hold a balance in.

<a id="balance"></a>
### `balance`

The `balance` attribute supports:

* `cash` - Funds the user can spend right now.
* `inbound_pending` - Funds not spendable yet, but will become available at a later time.
* `outbound_pending` - Funds in the account, but not spendable because they are being held for pending outbound flows.

<a id="financial_addresses"></a>
### `financial_addresses`

The `financial_addresses` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `aba` - ABA Records contain U.S. bank account details per the ABA format. See [`financial_addresses.aba`](#financial_addresses.aba) below.
* `supported_networks` - The list of networks that the address supports
* `type` - The type of financial address Possible values: `aba`.

<a id="financial_addresses.aba"></a>
### `financial_addresses.aba`

The `financial_addresses.aba` attribute supports:

* `account_holder_name` - The name of the person or business that owns the bank account.
* `account_number` - (Sensitive) The account number.
* `account_number_last4` - The last four characters of the account number.
* `bank_name` - Name of the bank.
* `routing_number` - Routing number for the account.

<a id="platform_restrictions"></a>
### `platform_restrictions`

The `platform_restrictions` attribute supports:

* `inbound_flows` - Restricts all inbound money movement. Possible values: `restricted`, `unrestricted`.
* `outbound_flows` - Restricts all outbound money movement. Possible values: `restricted`, `unrestricted`.

<a id="status_details"></a>
### `status_details`

The `status_details` attribute supports:

* `closed` - Details related to the closure of this FinancialAccount See [`status_details.closed`](#status_details.closed) below.

<a id="status_details.closed"></a>
### `status_details.closed`

The `status_details.closed` attribute supports:

* `reasons` - The array that contains reasons for a FinancialAccount closure.
